endorsements.name: Doan Nguyen
endorsements.label: CVE-2019-25286
endorsements.description: GCafé 3.0 contains an unquoted service path vulnerability in the gbClientService that allows local attackers to potentially execute arbitrary code with elevated privileges. Attackers can exploit the unquoted path in the service configuration to inject malicious executables that will be run with LocalSystem permissions.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: HIGH (CVSS 4.0, 8.5)

endorsements.name: Doan Nguyen
endorsements.label: CVE-2019-25362
endorsements.description: WMV to AVI MPEG DVD WMV Convertor 4.6.1217 contains a buffer overflow vulnerability that allows attackers to execute arbitrary code by overwriting the license name and license code fields. Attackers can craft a malicious payload of 6000 bytes to trigger a bind shell on port 4444 by exploiting a stack-based buffer overflow in the application's input handling.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: CRITICAL (CVSS 3.1, 9.8)
